title: AB-Cloud Research Programme: Unified Academic Package
description: The unified academic edition of the AB-Cloud research programme: spectral core (V01-V20, Th1-Th6), Dirac skeleton (D1-D14), Hilbert-Polya bridge (C1-C17, T1-T18) and blind verification (E01-E18). Includes the unified monograph (RU/EN full volumes), web laboratory, six-language CLI and a complete honesty layer. RH status: blocked by design.
